title: Repealing Exception 4 (sudden fight) — a hypothetical amendment
summary: Exception 4 removes murder liability where death is caused in a sudden fight, in the heat of passion, without premeditation and without undue advantage. This hypothetical amendment repeals the exception and leaves everything else untouched. It is the cleanest possible demonstration: one statutory sentence disappears, and the tool reports exactly which cases change side.

source.citation: Hypothetical. Written to demonstrate a before/after comparison on a real provision, not to propose a change.

expected_reading: Cases that relied on Exception 4 — sudden fight, no undue advantage, and a mental element that would otherwise be murder — become murder instead of culpable homicide not amounting to murder. Nothing else should move.
